governance.parent: Minister of Culture and National Heritage

basis: The statute on the BIP page (annex to the Minister's order, as amended in June 2026) calls it a state cultural institution organised by the Minister and says the Minister appoints and dismisses the director (section 7).

governance.parent: Minister of Culture and National Heritage

basis: The Bylaws annexed to the Minister's order of 5 December 2012 (sections 1, 3 and 6) call it a state cultural institution with the Minister as organizer and say the Minister appoints and dismisses the director; the gallery's own About page of December 2025 still links these Bylaws.

The statute adopted by City Council resolution of 24 November 2022 (sections 1 and 5) calls it a municipal cultural institution run by Gmina Wrocław and says the Mayor of Wrocław appoints the director.

governance.parent: Minister of Culture and National Heritage and Łódź Voivodeship (joint organisers)

basis: The statute granted by the Minister's order of 29 September 2015 (sections 1, 2 and 11) makes it a joint cultural institution of the Minister and the Voivodeship with legal personality, with the director appointed by the Minister in agreement with the Voivodeship.
Note 1 to the 2025 financial statements (page 17) says it is a non-profit institution created by the will of its founder and given public utility status by Decree-Law 40690 of 1956.

The consolidated statutes (articles 2, 8, 13) call it a private foundation whose bodies are designated by Caixa Geral de Depósitos, which approves its budget and annual programme, and whose executive board hires its staff.
The Mission page of the gallery's own site describes it as a non-profit cultural association founded by civil initiative in 1994.
The About page of the centre's own site says it is a project of XEREM, a non-profit cultural association.

The 2017 report of Fundação EDP (page 12) says the foundation is a private non-profit institution created by EDP in 2004 and presents MAAT as its museum; the MAAT About page places the museum within the foundation's patronage and names the foundation as holder of its collections.
